title: OpenAI signs up to $11.9B cloud contract with CoreWeave

sources.quote: As of March 31, 2025, subject to the satisfaction of delivery and availability of service requirements, OpenAI has committed to pay the Company up to $11.9 billion through October 2030.
The contract value for this strategic deal is up to $11.9 billion.

explain: OpenAI agreed to pay CoreWeave up to $11.9 billion through October 2030 to rent GPU computing capacity for training and running its models. It made OpenAI one of CoreWeave's biggest customers just before CoreWeave's stock market listing.
